summary.text: Mike Mazzei is the Republican nominee for governor. He served in the Oklahoma Senate from 2004 to 2016 and as Gov. Kevin Stitt's Secretary of Budget from 2019 to 2020, and runs a Tulsa wealth-management firm.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in government and politics from George Mason University; founded The Financial Coach Inc. and is chairman and CEO of Trinity Strategic Wealth in Tulsa.
Represented Oklahoma Senate District 25 from 2004 until term limits in 2016.
Served as Oklahoma Secretary of Budget under Gov. Stitt, 2019–2020; ended a 2021 campaign for state treasurer a month after announcing it.
